plugins.name: support-rma-genie
plugins.description: RMA Genie: Raise standardized OPS RMA Jira tickets for Solace appliance hardware replacements (PSU/ADB/NAB/SFP/full appliance): parses an extracted gather-diagnostics bundle, applies the Platinum / Platinum+ conventions, previews for review, then creates the ticket via the Atlassian MCP.
